EPISODE 1: THE FROZEN RING
Meadow Hollow. Dawn. In six hours, the Frozen Ring Championship begins.
FROSTI! Wake up, wake up, WAKE UP! It came! The letter came!
...Bolt. The sun isn't even up.
Frosti and Bolt of Meadow Hollow: you are invited to the Final. THE FINAL, Frosti!
Us? We're rookies. Who even sent that?
Doesn't say. It's sealed with a little crystal of ice. Fancy!
The crystal hums. Only Frosti can hear it.
...find me...
Did you hear that?
Hear what? Come on. One practice roll before we go. Loser buys snacks!
Okay, OKAY. You're good. Don't let it go to your head.
Snacks are on you.
To the Frozen Ring, champ. Let's go make history.

hotstreak: THE FROZEN RING
Forty thousand fans. One ring of ancient ice, floating over nothing at all.
HELLOOOO FROZEN RING! It's your girl LUMI, live, loud and on ICE!
It's the Championship Final! Rookies FROSTI and BOLT against the defending champions, VEX and HOTSTREAK!
Rookies. They let rookies into the Final now?
Two rookies, one round. I'll be home for dinner.
You got this, Frosti! Show him the frozen comet!
Then he can start by falling off.
We'll see who falls.
A shadow sweeps across the ice. Forty thousand fans go silent.
No. Way. Folks, that is DRACORIA! Queen of the Frozen Ring! She has not flown in a hundred years!
A DRAGON?! Nobody said there was a DRAGON!
The crystal from the letter... it's humming again. She's looking right at me.
Watch the sky, rookie. Her ice breath doesn't care whose turn it is.
Dracoria lands on her islet, folds her wings, and watches. Waiting.
In the royal box, Master Orin, founder of the Rings, has not blinked once.
And under the ice, something very old opens one eye.
Zoogis, take your places! Let's! ROLL!
Story_EP1_P1
MATCH POINT! The ring belongs to the ice! FROSTI AND BOLT ARE YOUR NEW CHAMPIONS!
...Lucky shot.
Rematch. Soon. Count on it.
That wasn't luck, Vex! That was MY best friend!
The trophy rises. In its heart burns the Frost Core, the light that holds the ring together.
Story_EP1_P2
Thank you, champions. Your cheering woke me.
Wh-what is THAT? That is NOT on the run sheet!
A thousand years under the ice. I remember every single one.
No. It cannot be. Everyone, off the ring! NOW!
Vex! Grab my hand! We jump together!
Story_EP1_P3
Run, little champions. Let's see how you roll when the floor is falling.
In the stands, Nightshade's eyes flare red. He drops onto the breaking ice between them and the edge.
The master says you stay.
Story_EP1_P4
The Frozen Ring falls into the dark. Frosti and Vex made it out. Barely.
...Where am I? Why is everything so cold?
The Shadow reached into his heart. He can do that to any Zoogi who is afraid. Remember it.
Frosti... what WAS that thing?
He was the First Champion. The strongest Zoogi who ever rolled.
Was?
We sealed him beneath the Rings. Five rings, five cores, five locks. I helped bury him.
And now he's stealing the cores. One lock down. Four to go.
The next one is the Ember Core. In the Caldera. My home.
You caught me back there, rookie. Don't make it a habit. This is my fight.
...We're following her.
Obviously.
TO BE CONTINUED

hotstreak: EPISODE 2: EMBER RISING
The Sunscorch Dunes. Three days of sand between Frosti and the Caldera.
Three days of sand, Frosti. My circuits are cooking.
Vex went this way. We keep rolling.
Sure. Totally normal desert. Except... the sand is moving wrong.
Story_EP2_P1
A wrapped figure claws up out of the dunes. Wraps, champion of the sands. His eyes burn red.
The sand belongs to him now. So do you.
Shadows! He's making copies of himself. Back to back, Frosti!
They crumble into sand when they lose. Good. That means they CAN lose.
...The red is gone. Thank you, little ones. He went toward the volcano.
You think Vex is okay out here alone?
Vex? She acts like stone. She's really lava. You'll see.
The Ember Caldera. A city built inside a living volcano. Vex's home.
Story_EP2_P2
I told you not to follow me.
And I told you we'd see who falls.
My family has guarded the Ember Core for nine generations. I won't let a rookie walk into the Heart.
You want in? Get past the gate. Hotstreak guards it.
Told you. Rematch.
He's serious, Frosti.
So am I.
...Nobody gets past me. Nobody.
...You don't roll like a rookie.
And you don't roll like someone who wants to fight alone.
My mother guarded this core. One night she walked into the Heart and never came out.
Everyone said she fell. I think she saw something.
Then let's go see it. Together.
...Fine. But I lead.
Deep below, the Caldera Heart rumbles. Something is already inside.
Story_EP2_P3
They win the fight. They lose the core.
You fight well, flame-child. Your mother fought well too.
She found the truth. Ask your old Master what the Rings really are.
Story_EP2_P4
...Orin knew. He KNEW.
Frosti, look. A rune on the wall. A spiral. That's the mark of the Sunken Archive.
Sera's archive. If anyone knows the truth, it's her.
TO BE CONTINUED

hotstreak: EPISODE 3: STORM SEASON
The Sunken Archive. Every Ring battle ever rolled is carved into these walls.
Story_EP3_P1
You came for the truth. The truth is heavy. Can you carry it?
We have to.
Look at the founding wall. Five founders. Five rings. And one Zoogi in chains beneath them.
Is that... Master Orin? Holding the chains?
It is. The Rings were never a game. They are a cage. Every cheer, every roll, drains the one inside.
So every match we ever won... kept him locked up.
Now you see why the Rune Seal is guarded. I must test your heart before I give it.
Your heart is loud. But it is kind. Take the Seal.
A spiral of light settles into Frosti's hand.
FROSTI! Are you getting this?! I need you at the Neon Circuit, NOW!
Story_EP3_P2
Okay, Neon Circuit, we are LIVE and... wait. Why is my signal red?
People of the Rings. I am the one you cheered into chains.
Your champion knows the truth now. Ask him why he still fights for the cage.
Frosti, don't listen to him--
The lights die. Bolt screams. And then there is nothing.
BOLT!
Out of the dark roll Pinpoint and Lars. Their eyes burn red.
Pinpoint? Lars? They're shadow-touched! Roll, Frosti! I'll keep every camera on you!
Blackout Brawl winner: FROSTI! ...but where's Bolt?
...My head. Frosti? We were... fighting you?
On the floor lies a spark of yellow lightning, slowly turning grey.
He took Bolt into the storm over Meadow Hollow. Your home.
Then that's where I'm going.
Meadow Hollow. The sky is black. The grass lies flat under the wind.
Story_EP3_P3
Hey, Frosti. Took you long enough.
Bolt? Your eyes...
He showed me everything. A thousand years in the ice. Because they were SCARED of him.
And you'd put him right back. Wouldn't you, champ?
I don't know what I'd do. But I know I'm bringing you home.
Then come and get me. Loser buys snacks.
Frosti presses the Rune Seal to Bolt's chest. The shadow tears out of him like smoke.
Story_EP3_P4
...Frosti? Did I... did I win?
No. Snacks are on you.
Heh. Worth it.
It is time I told you all of it.
We sealed him because he was stronger than all five of us together. Not because he had done anything wrong.
I have been afraid for a thousand years. I am done being afraid.
The last ring waits at the end of the sky. I will take you there.
TO BE CONTINUED
EPISODE 4: VOID CALLING
The Skyward Plateau. The last stair before the sky runs out.
The Titan Core is my lock. Mine to guard. He will come for it here.
Then let him come. Bolt and I hold the left side.
Every camera I own is pointed up. The whole world is watching, Frosti.
The sky splits open. Out of the storm roll Tavi and Moss, the Plateau's own guardians, eyes burning red.
Step aside, old master. The gate is his now.
Frosti. Roll with me.
Master Orin? I... I'm sorry. I couldn't stop it.
The gate holds. ...No. It opens.
The Titan Core rises out of the stone and flies into the sky, as if something is calling it home.
He has all five. The cage is open. Go, Frosti. Finish what I started.
The Void Ring. A ring of stars at the end of the sky. Five stolen cores burn above it like a crown.
You came. All the way to the end of the sky.
The cage is broken, little champion. Now the Rings will learn what it is to be forgotten.
You were wronged. I know. But if you tear everything down, you're just building a new cage.
Pretty words. Let's see if they can roll.
Together, Frosti. Like always.
The shadows fall away. Only he remains.
Enough. Just you and me. The way this was always going to end.
Just you and me.
The last roll stops at the very edge of the ring.
...So. Seal me again. That is how this story goes.
No. That's how THEIR story went.
Frosti lifts the Rune Seal... and breaks it.
The five cores scatter into the sky as light. No cage. No locks. Just the Rings, and everyone who loves them.
...Why?
Because you deserved a match you could walk away from.
...Then I will watch the next one. From the stands.
Folks, I... I don't have words. For once. That's the show.
So, champ. Who's buying snacks?
THE END ... FOR NOW
EPISODE 5: RING GUARD
One week after the Void Ring. The five cores are free... and every Ring in the world has gone dark.
Champ. I can't roll. I push and nothing happens. It's like the floor forgot us.
The cores powered the Rings. Free cores, sleeping Rings. Until they choose to come home, no Zoogi rolls anywhere.
And it gets worse, folks. Something is climbing out of the dark arenas. Empty armour. Purple eyes. No one inside.
Hollows. The shadows I left behind. They have no master now... so they take whatever is not guarded.
Then we guard it. Long before the Rings, Zoogis stood on two feet. Come. The Ring Guard armoury has waited a thousand years.
Stone doors grind open. Suits of armour, one for every Zoogi - each helmet shaped like the face that wears it.
Armour in your colours. Your own face on your shoulders. You fight on foot now. First: prove you can. Last one standing.
Okay. Okay! Walking is weird, but that was AWESOME.
You stand like a guard, Frosti. The armour is yours.
Reports from the Caldera. Vex is training his own squad. He says the Ember gate does not need "rookies in tin".
Ember Caldera. The lava has cooled to black glass. Two suits of red armour wait on the far side.
So the old stone gave you a suit too. Cute. Hotstreak and I held this gate before you could roll in a straight line.
Then show me. Your squad against mine. First to twenty. Winner leads the line at the Archive.
Finally. Somebody say go.
...Tch. Fine. You lead. But I'm on your left side, rookie, and I am not carrying you.
Frosti! The Sunken Archive - the founding wall is where the cores were born. The Hollows are coming for it. All of them.
The Sunken Archive. One doorway. One guard, a soldier of the old Ring Guard at his side, and a turret older than the Rings.
Five waves, by my count. If the wall falls, the cores never come home.
I made these things. I will not cheer for them. Hold the line, little champion. I am watching. From the stands.
Nobody gets past me.
The last Hollow falls. The armour is empty. It always was.
Above the founding wall, five lights drift down out of the sky... and settle into the stone, one by one.
They came back. Not caged. They CHOSE to come back.
Champ! The floor! I can feel the floor! WE CAN ROLL!
Keep the armour, Frosti. A Ring that is worth rolling on is worth standing guard over.
Rings are live, the Guard is on duty, and I am BACK on the air! What a week!
THE RING GUARD STANDS
